name: Centraid
description: The shell's own reads: the questions that are not one app's (what Home shows, a search across the vault, the chat's history, the backup's status). One catalogue for the shell, parsed like an app's manifest but not one of the eight apps, so chat and the training harness never see it.

queries.name: backup-status
queries.description: Where this vault's backup stands, read from the phone's own ledger without dialling anyone: the gateways it is paired with, when one last acknowledged the head (the gateway's clock), how many photos and files are confirmed of how many the vault knows, what waits and why, and this phone's clock for wording. Re-read whenever a pass, a pairing or a forget moves the ledger, or the vault's files change.
